description.en:
Chooses which team takes the next kick-off that the match sets up by itself (at the start of the match or a half, or after a goal), instead of the team the engine would pick. The choice is kept until that kick-off uses it, then cleared.
CMND_BTL_SET_MATCH_RESTART, which sets up a kick-off immediately, goes through the same request internally.
The only shipped use is btl0302.nut, which gives the first kick-off to team 1 in its pre-match setup.
Team that kicks off: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Always null (also when no argument is given).

examples.case: The opponent kicks off first (real usage, from btl0302.nut)
